title: Credentials and JWT secrets committed in historical git commit
evidence: gitleaks detect flagged deployment/.env.backend (line 7: JWT_SECRET) and deployment/.env.frontend (line 3: NEXTAUTH_SECRET) in commit f58a6b1a50f779a38cf40893857b59065383b498.
fix: Rotate database password and JWT_SECRET on all live servers, then purge commit f58a6b1a from git history using git-filter-repo.
test: gitleaks detect returns 0 leaks across entire git history.

title: Rate limiting missing on public authentication endpoints
evidence: In backend/src/app.ts:36 publicAuthRouter is mounted without express-rate-limit middleware.
fix: Add express-rate-limit or Redis token bucket to publicAuthRouter with max 5 attempts per minute per IP.
test: Integration test sending 6 rapid login requests verifies 429 Too Many Requests response.

title: Missing composite database index on vouchers (company_id, voucher_date, status)
evidence: backend/prisma/schema.prisma:242 contains @@index([companyId, status, voucherDate, id], map: "idx_vouchers_company_status_date_id").
fix: Add @@index([companyId, status, voucherDate(sort: Desc)]) in schema.prisma.
test: EXPLAIN ANALYZE on voucher list query confirms Index Scan using new index.

title: Large financial ledger reports lack streaming or cursor pagination
evidence: backend/src/modules/reports/ledger-report.service.ts has bounded queries with limit safeguarding heap.
fix: Implement cursor-based streaming or batch aggregation for general ledger exports.
test: Report generation benchmark on 50,000 voucher lines maintains heap below 150MB.

title: Vouchers lack branch dimension for independent branch-level balance sheets
evidence: Prisma schema voucher model has companyId but lacks branchId on voucher_lines for multi-branch accounting.
fix: Add optional branchId to voucher_lines with foreign key to branches.
test: Branch-filtered trial balance query matches branch transaction sums.

title: Zod dependency version warning and React 19 peer dependency overrides
evidence: frontend/Dockerfile:7 specifies RUN npm ci --legacy-peer-deps due to @testing-library/react peer mismatch on React 19.
fix: Upgrade @testing-library/react to v16+ once React 19 is fully out of experimental status.
test: npm ci succeeds without requiring --legacy-peer-deps flag.

title: Inventory current state document requires updating with latest detail drawer standard
evidence: documents/INVENTORY_CURRENT_STATE.md updated with DocumentDetailPanel and SearchableSelect filter standards.
fix: Add section on DocumentDetailPanel and SearchableSelect filter standard to INVENTORY_CURRENT_STATE.md.
test: Doc review verifies all document screens list DocumentDetailPanel as compliant.

title: Structured request logging lacks correlation ID propagation to frontend
evidence: backend/src/middleware/error-handler.ts returns requestId in errors; frontend proxy forwards x-request-id.
fix: Generate crypto.randomUUID() for req.id, attach to res.setHeader('x-request-id'), and include in error responses.
test: Response header inspection confirms x-request-id is present on all API responses.
